facts.fact: ITLawCo states the Data Protection Act came into force on 3 June 2024 and that sections 38-40 restrict transfers of personal data outside Malawi unless the receiving country has adequate data protection laws or mechanisms such as binding corporate rules are in place.

ITLawCo states that after the Act took effect MACRA published a Data Protection Handbook, which it says details safeguards for transferring personal data outside Malawi, including documentation and approval processes; the document gives no date for the Handbook, so the document's published year 2024 is used.

systems.owner: Malawi Communications Regulatory Authority (data protection authority)
